title: Pattern resolved: TRN-117 clock module replaced
description: Erkki finds the cause of the evening drops: the clock module on TRN-117 drifts when the site cooling cycles, and TRN-131 and TRN-229 take their timing from it. He replaces the module. A lasting fix bound to the shared neighbour: the linked pattern closes on its own, with no confirmation step.
subject: Evening drops on TRN-131 / TRN-229

messages.text: Erkki, the night shift keeps resetting TRN-229 and rebooting TRN-131 in the evenings. Any idea?
Found it. The clock module on TRN-117 drifts when the cooling at Linnanmaa cycles around 21:00, and both TRN-131 and TRN-229 take their timing over TRN-117. The resets only hid it.
Replaced the clock module on TRN-117 this morning. Timing has been stable since.
Great, thanks. I'll tell the night shift.

items.summary: The clock module on TRN-117 drifted when the site cooling cycled in the evening, taking timing down for TRN-131 and TRN-229; it was replaced.
items.diagnosis: clock module drift on TRN-117 when the cooling cycles
items.action: Replace the clock module on TRN-117.
avoid: resetting the timing port or rebooting line cards on the downstream nodes as a fix
